description: This file defines a utility function `ping_host` to check the reachability of a network host by attempting to connect to port 80 and measuring the response time.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,float] ping_host(host: str, timeout: int = 3)
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the specified host on port 80 within a timeout (default 3 seconds) and returns a tuple indicating reachability and response time in milliseconds.
